concept.title: Childcare and family support
concept.shortdesc: Childcare, early years sessions, baby and parenting classes, parent meet-ups and support for families and children with additional needs.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Informal opportunities for parents and carers to meet, chat and support each other, including parent groups and workshops.
: Childcare after the school day, including wrap-around care and school pick-up.
: Informal play sessions for young children with toys, crafts, stories, songs and refreshments, including stay-and-play and playgroup sessions.
: Classes, courses and workshops on pregnancy, birth, baby feeding and caring for babies, with some training for professionals.
: Information, advice and support for parents, children and whole families on family life and parenting.
: Children attending a nursery or day nursery for sessions of care and early education.
: Early years care and education such as day care, funded nursery or daycare places and school-based early years provision.
: Support for children and young people with special educational needs or additional needs in schools and specialist settings, including support to schools.
